title: The Database Disaster Test
facebook_comment_text: Having geographically diverse, auto-replicating backups is crucial, but the real challenge is validating your RTO/RPO. Many organizations discover their 'minutes' restoration goal hits a snag during actual, full-scale recovery drills. 💡 How often does your team perform non-destructive restore tests, and what's the biggest bottleneck you've uncovered?
